_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Hope band with stalled 30d change and pinned funding/momentum; coil base rate plus cancelled CVD and dead ETF flows argue no breaker for climb or flush.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both compatible with non-trending caution; analyst explicit HOLD/Hope, narrative supply note does not demand DOWN or phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays near flat and Fear & Greed holds ~58-70 with momentum and funding still ~45-55
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 71 with 30d momentum through ~70 (Optimism) or F&G drops below 55 with momentum and funding rolling over (Disbelief)
